description.narrative: Title: Eswatini Silele Community Programme Start and End dates: 1st Oct 2019 31st March 2022 Summary: Working through the Baphalali Eswatini Red Cross Clinic in Silele we are reaching the community through three elements 1) Water and Sanitation Rehabilitation of the Water system for the Silele Clinic Water Committees Rain water Harvesting and water tank construction Train BERCS staff in WASH Hand washing facilities at schools and awareness Demonstration HHs 2) Menstrual Hygiene Management Learning workshop with Malawi Lesotho and Uganda RC Parental support groups Teen clubs training Making sanitary pads (potentially) Construct MHM friendly latrine at Silele Clinic Awareness raising for PSEA 3) Nutrition Awareness raising on healthy eating and indigenous foods Key hole gardens demonstration at Silele Clinic Cooking demonstrations Community Nutritional status database Food supplements for mothers and children Anthropometric kits for the Clinic Location: Silele Clinic and Community in the Shiselweni region Bens: Unknown at the moment Donor: Di Moody Legacy Fund - 350 000 PPL - 12 250 Finnish Red Cross - 55 000 PNSs: Finnish Red Cross Costs: Around 409 250 total for the programme Current Situation (Dec 2019) : Assessment phase is ongoing from Oct 19 - March 20. A Wash officer as been hired who will start in Jan 2020. The MHM workshop took place in Nov 19 govt are still unsure around reusable sanitary pads. In depth assessment plans are being established for the next 2/3 months before the final programme design is completed and confirmed
